description: Harborline Distribution, a synthetic mid-size industrial wholesaler. Rows run from 2024-01-01 through 2025-12-31. Currency is USD. Tables live in schema harborline. Qualify SQL as harborline.table_name. Recognized revenue is order_lines.line_amount.

measures.description: Recognized revenue in USD. Fulfilled quantity times unit price, dated by orders.order_date.
measures.name: recognized_revenue

measures.description: Share of inbound receipts that are a late delivery.
measures.expression: avg(case when late_days > 0 then 1 else 0 end)
measures.name: late_receipt_rate

measures.description: Nights a warehouse and SKU had a stockout, on-hand zero.
measures.name: stockout_days
